details:
This is a deeply empathetic idea with immense human value. Preserving and centralizing the memories of a loved one in a single place—where their friends can share photos, stories, and happy moments—transforms grief into a space of collaborative tribute and collective comfort.

​📌 Concept Name

​MEMORIAL ACCOUNT: MEMORY WALL

​💡 Rationale and Purpose

​When a friend or active community member passes away, their digital footprint often remains scattered across different platforms or private conversations. Creating this special status aims to provide a respectful space to:

​Honor Their Memory: Unify shared photos, screenshots, and moments.

​Support Community Grieving: Allow close friends to share anecdotes, reflect on happy times, and offer mutual comfort.

​Preserve Their Legacy: Prevent the account from being lost to inactivity or having their contributions forgotten over time.

​🛠️ Proposed Mechanics and Functionality

​1. Respectful Verification

​Support Request: Verified friends or family members submit a request through the official support channel.

​Confirmation: The support/moderation team validates the information before transitioning the account state to prevent misuse.

​2. Account and Interface Changes

​Memorial Badge/Status: The account receives a subtle visual badge (such as the 🕊️ icon or a special tag) indicating that the profile is in memorial mode.

​Read-Only Mode: Direct messages and active notifications are disabled to protect the original privacy of the profile.

​3. The "Memory & Story Wall"

​Collaborative Gallery: A special tab on the profile opens, allowing added friends to upload photographs taken with the deceased user.

​Anecdote Section: A dedicated comment space exclusively for sharing positive stories, fun moments, and heartfelt words.

​Community Moderation: Options for family or designated admins to keep the section respectful and free of inappropriate content.

​"Transforming the profile of someone who has passed into a living book of memories allows their light to keep shining for those who loved them."

​En memoria de PauletteTheHoe.
title: FEATURE SUGGESTION: MEMORIAL ACCOUNT MODE (For deceased users).
